messages:
From: Alex Townsend <partners@cloudscale.com>

Cc: Millennium Health <procurement@millenniumhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Co-sell: marketplace metadata + certification asks

Hi Jordan / Ben,

Thanks again for the call last week — CloudScale is ready to move forward with a joint listing across AWS, Azure, and GCP. Millennium Health is lined up as a pilot customer and procurement wanted a clear artifacts list so they can accelerate purchasing. High-level asks from our side: 

- Marketplace metadata and SKU model: what fields do you require (pricing unit, metering type, sku_id mapping)?
- Co-sell certification evidence: SOC2/ISO excerpts, technical integration test results, tenant isolation notes.
- Integration shim guidance: we have a small shim that routes auth + metering; does Redwood require any runtime telemetry or endpoint schemas?
- Timeline: CloudScale would like to target marketplace listing by Aug 1; what are realistic gating items?

I've attached a quick integration-specs.xlsx and a first-pass legal_SOW_draft.pdf for context (attachments listed below). Can we schedule a 30-min sync this week to assign owners?

Attachments: integration-specs.xlsx (xlsx), legal_SOW_draft.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Alex Townsend
Head of Partnerships
CloudScale Consulting
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Townsend <partners@cloudscale.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Co-sell: marketplace metadata + certification asks

Alex — thanks for the clear list. Quick replies inline, plus proposed next steps.

- Marketplace metadata / SKU: Redwood requires sku_id, billing_unit (instance/hour | GB/month | invocation), meter_namespace, and a short description. We can accept CloudScale-owned sku_ids but need a mapping file in CSV.
- Co-sell evidence: please share SOC2 report excerpts and an architecture diagram that highlights data residency/isolation. Legal SOW looks fine; procurement usually wants the SLA clause called out.
- Integration shim: runtime telemetry we need: request_id, tenant_id, model_variant, token_count (if applicable), and booleans for caching_enabled / kv_cache_hit. A small HTTP endpoint that posts JSON batched events is ideal.
- Timeline: gating items are evidence binder + SKU mapping + a technical sample (demo tenant) for Marketplace validation. If we get those by June 20 we can aim for an Aug 1 publish.

Next steps (proposed):
1) CloudScale to drop a sku_map.csv and SOC2 excerpts into a shared Drive.
2) Olga to run a quick evidence triage and produce a missing-items list.
3) Vivek to scope the shim verification tests and give an ETA for test harness.
4) Schedule a 30-min alignment (week of Jun 12) — propose Tue 12:00 PT.

I attached a starter co-sell-evidence-matrix.csv (small) that Ben and Olga can expand.

Jordan Blake
Sr. Partner Manager, Redwood Inference

Alex / team — adding a few operational specifics that AWS/Azure/GCP teams ask for during listing and co-sell reviews: 

1) Metering endpoints and SKU mapping
   - We expect a csv with columns: sku_id, partner_sku_id, billing_unit, meter_namespace, price_per_unit, supported_regions
   - For metering, a simple HTTP ingestion endpoint that accepts batched events (JSON array) with request_id, sku_id, timestamp, units_consumed is sufficient. We can provide a reference client.

2) Co-sell evidence matrix (attached) — highlights minimum artifacts: SOC2 summary, integration smoke test results (pass/fail with logs), security contact, support SLAs, and a demo tenant link.

3) Certification shim tests — Vivek, request your team to confirm the following automated checks: auth handshake (token exchange), idempotent meter receipts, and kv-cache isolation for multi-tenant flows. If the shim exposes a /health and /metrics endpoint we can automate validation.

HubSpot deal link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/70921 — would be great if CloudScale can add the sku_map upload there as an attachment for tracking.

I attached co-sell-evidence-matrix.csv (csv).

—Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Alliances
Redwood Inference
